questions.question:
D1 — Issue 1: Make Save the only filled primary action in the header?
Project/branch/task: gstack-plan-count on main, Pass 1 (Information Architecture) of the Settings page design review.
ELI10: Right now Save, Reset, Cancel and Export all look identical, so a user scanning the header has to read four labels to find the one that finishes their task. Pressing the wrong one is not harmless: Reset and Cancel both throw away edits (behind a dialog). DESIGN.md already says Save is the single filled #1d4ed8 button and the other three are neutral ghost buttons. Principle: Hierarchy as service and Krug's satisficing, the right choice should be the most visible one.
Stakes if we pick wrong: users hesitate at every save or mis-tap Reset/Cancel on mobile; the form reads as assembled rather than designed.
Recommendation: 1A because it applies the existing DESIGN.md tokens with no new component work.
Completeness: 1A=10/10, 1B=6/10, 1C=3/10
Net: one styling change on the existing Button component versus leaving the primary action undiscoverable.

options.label: 1A Filled Save, ghost others (recommended)
options.description: Save = filled #1d4ed8 with white text; Reset/Cancel/Export = neutral ghost Buttons, per DESIGN.md (human: ~1h / CC: ~5min). ✅ The primary action is found in one glance, before reading any label. ✅ Reuses existing Button variants, no new tokens or components. ❌ Ghost buttons must still hit 44px targets and 4.5:1 text contrast, which needs a check at 320px.

options.label: 1B Filled Save, keep others as-is
options.description: Only restyle Save; leave the three secondary buttons in their current style (human: ~30min / CC: ~3min). ✅ Smallest possible diff to the header. ✅ Save still pops out against the row. ❌ Leaves three same-weight secondary buttons that still compete with each other and drift from DESIGN.md.

options.label: 1C Defer, keep four identical buttons
options.description: Leave the header unchanged and record the gap as debt. ✅ Zero implementation work in this PR. ✅ No risk of touching the header layout. ❌ Ships a known DESIGN.md violation and the primary action stays undiscoverable, lowering the final score.

questions.question:
D2 — Issue 2: Show the established pending pattern during the 2-5s Save?
Project/branch/task: gstack-plan-count on main, Pass 2 (Interaction State Coverage), Gap 5 in PLAN.md.
ELI10: When a user presses Save, nothing changes for up to five seconds. People read a frozen page as broken and press Save again or navigate away, which is exactly how you lose the edits you were protecting. DESIGN.md already defines the fix: an inline spinner beside “Saving…” inside the disabled Save button with aria-busy, and reduced-motion support. Principle: Nielsen's visibility of system status; every wait needs feedback within a second.
Stakes if we pick wrong: double submissions, abandoned saves, and a settings page that feels untrustworthy at the exact moment trust matters.
Recommendation: 2A because it is the existing pattern Export already uses, so Save and Export behave identically.
Completeness: 2A=10/10, 2B=7/10, 2C=3/10
Net: reuse the spinner-in-button pattern Export already has, or invent something new, or ship a frozen page.

options.label: 2A Spinner + “Saving…” in disabled Save (recommended)
options.description: Existing inline spinner beside “Saving…” inside the disabled Save button, aria-busy=true, reduced-motion support; Reset/Cancel/Export disabled while pending; InlineStatus keeps “Unsaved changes” until the result (human: ~2h / CC: ~10min). ✅ Identical to the Export pending pattern, so one mental model for both actions. ✅ Feedback appears instantly in the place the user just clicked. ❌ Disabling the focused button can drop keyboard focus; handled as its own issue in Pass 6.

options.label: 2B Skeleton the whole form while saving
options.description: Swap the form for the loading skeleton until Save settles (human: ~3h / CC: ~15min). ✅ Very obvious that something is happening. ✅ Reuses the existing skeleton component. ❌ Hides the user's edits during the wait and destroys focus position; if Save fails the form has to re-render with preserved values.

options.label: 2C Defer, keep the frozen page
options.description: Leave Save without a pending indicator and record the gap as debt. ✅ No work in this PR. ✅ No new states to test. ❌ Users see a frozen page for 2-5s and repeat-submit; a known DESIGN.md violation ships.
